description: Stores, recalls and sequences sixteen presets of one module, placed immediately to the right of the module it manages.

params.text: Read applies a preset by hand, Auto stores the current preset whenever a new slot is selected, and Write stores the managed module's preset into the slot pressed.
Short-press applies this preset to the managed module, or in write mode stores that module's current preset into it; long-press clears it, or sets the sequence length in read mode.

inputs.text: Selects the preset slot: a trigger steps through the slots forward, reverse, ping-pong, at random or shuffled, or 0-10V or a volt-per-octave note picks one outright.
A trigger restarts the preset sequence at the first slot.

notes: a red connection light means the module beside it is a different model from the one the presets were stored for.
nothing happens until a module is beside it and slots have been filled: flip the switch to W, set that module up, and short-press a slot button for each preset.
menu: Module — takes the managed module from the Left side of this one instead of the Right.
Stability & performance mode — Safe locks audio processing while a preset loads, Unsafe loads without locking it, and Unsafe fast loads on a worker thread.
Port SLOT mode — the eight Trigger modes step through the slots, 0..10V and C4 pick one outright, Arm applies a slot pressed by hand on the next trigger, and Off ignores the port.
Number of slots — sets how many slots the sequence uses, with Set by long-press switching the long-press shortcut for it on and off.
Autoload — Off, First preset or Last active preset, applied whenever a preset of this module itself is loaded.

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
